Architecture ​

Layers ​

┌─ clients ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ widget.js (web, one <script>)  ·  your app (web view / native, docs/SDK-AUTH)   │
│ HTTPS + SSE · the client protocol (docs/CLIENT-PROTOCOL.md)                      │
└───────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                ▼
┌─ packages/gateway ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ middleware: otel → cors → headers → gateway key → json → login (verified)        │
│ per turn:   shape+owner → rate limit → usage cap → ROUTE → run → meter → nudge   │
│ super agent (router.ts): one domain per turn — a Verdict choice over domain      │
│   cards: keywords → decision model → LLM; sticky; single-domain shortcut         │
│ media (upload ≠ attach) · voice (STT) · nudges (SSE) · health · metrics          │
└───────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                ▼ runDomainAgent(domain, session, message)
┌─ packages/core ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ steps engine (pre-model): open ask? read in code → settle → chain → summary      │
│ prompt = identity + security preamble + capabilities + shared skills             │
│          + domain skills (typed: core + in-play type) + runtime facts            │
│ tool loop (≤ N rounds): set_type · guards (create gate, attested lists) · carry  │
│          → MCP call → draft (preview) · completion                               │
│ steps engine (post-model): late draw · summary card · redraw · dedupe · sanitize │
│ sessions · stores · trimming · llm chain · otel · logs                           │
└───────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                ▼ stdio MCP, token + trace context in _meta
┌─ domains/<name> (your code) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ domain.json · skills/*.md · mcp/server.ts (validate/preview/create + internal_*) │
│ schema/*.json · steps/index.ts · mock/policy.ts · probe/ · evals/                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
      ▲                                   ▲
      │ @marg-adk/verdict (typed decisions)   │ model chain: anthropic | openai-compatible | mock

One turn, in order ​

  1. Gate. Shape and length; the session resolves (hydrated on a miss) and the caller must own it (404 otherwise); a finished chat is 409 unless post-create edits are allowed; rate limits (per session, per IP, in-flight); usage caps (plan tokens → a 429 with the reset). All before any SSE header is written.
  2. Route. One domain, no re-classification mid-journey or after completion.
  3. Steps first. If a runtime ask is open, the reply is read in code: settle (the draft is written, the next owed step or the summary is drawn in the same reply), skip, redraw, or words (the model answers with a runtime fact; the ask is drawn again under its answer). If the summary is up, "Change something" opens the review. A runtime turn costs no model call.
  4. The model. System prompt (cached prefix) + the runtime facts for this turn (step notes, media note, the open-ask note) + history + the new message; tools for the in-play type.
  5. Tools. Each call: the runtime's own set_type; internal_* refused; the attested-list guard; the carry rule (settled step values override the model's); the create gate (summary shown for THIS draft + a whole-content yes); the MCP call with the token in _meta; the draft updated from the arguments (merge on validate, replace on preview/create); completion detected on created:true + id. Back to the model.
  6. Finalize. Prose and ui blocks split (tolerant of fence junk); an owed step late-drawn under the reply with the model's own ask cut; the summary card when everything settled and the draft is valid; dedupe; the link scheme allowlist; the turn stored with its final blocks.
  7. After. Metered (plan tokens into caps; the usage ledger; the metering sink), the nudge re-armed, pending media attached once an id exists, done sent with usage.

State ​

  • Session (persisted, token never): messages (windowed on turn boundaries and healed), usage, active domain and type, preview (the draft: slots, missing, refs, defaults, from-record, summary fingerprint, step states, edit state, identity), shared (media, scratch), completion.
  • Draft = what the last validate/preview/create carried + runtime state. The pane and the summary render from it; the carry rule reads it; a change of identity resets dependent steps.
  • Step state per key: asked (with the drawn block for reload) / settled (values, via, the settling message) / skipped.

Where things run ​

ConcernWhereWhy
Who may read a sessiongateway (owner check)a session id is an id, not a credential
Which domaingateway router (Verdict)typed decision, sticky, zero-cost with one domain
The system promptcore (per domain × type, cached)identical bytes keep provider caches warm
Reading a replycore readers + the step's readwhole-content rule, shared with evals
The create gatecore guard + the tool + the skillthree layers, never weakened
Validationthe domain's validate toolthe server may validate nothing
Uploadsgateway + the domain's internal_* toolsbytes never cross stdio as base64
CountersRedis (or memory)atomic windows across nodes
Sessions, ledgersMongo (or files)durable, lazily hydrated
Traces, metrics, logsOTLP → OpenObserve or any backendone trace per turn across processes

Entity types (variants) ​

A domain may declare types (product lines, document kinds). The prompt then carries the core skill + only the in-play type's skill, and the tool list only that type's validate/preview/ create tools (plus common tools). The type is set from the opener's words, restored from the draft on resume, or by the model through the runtime-provided set_type tool; a switch resets the draft the way a form resets. Each type lists its own steps order and flags.
